summary.zh: 设备进口通常需要提前确认 HS 编码、认证、标签和清关文件。
summary.en: Equipment imports usually require early confirmation of HS codes, certification, labeling, and customs documents.

body.zh: 建议将认证周期和清关不确定性纳入项目交付计划，避免组件、逆变器或电池系统到港后滞留。
body.en: Include certification lead times and customs uncertainty in delivery planning to avoid port delays for modules, inverters, or battery systems.
